_purpose: Which benefits combine, which exclude each other, and which are prerequisites. Resolution is deterministic — never inferred from semantic similarity.

rules.text: A LIHEAP benefit and PIPP enrolment may be held at the same time; the LIHEAP benefit is applied to the account and PIPP caps the ongoing monthly payment.
The arrearage reduction credit is only available to customers enrolled in PIPP. PIPP must be enrolled first.
A LIHEAP benefit does not reduce arrearage-reduction credit entitlement.
A customer on PIPP does not simultaneously carry a standard deferred payment arrangement on the same arrears — the arrearage credit replaces it.
Energy Affordability Program enrolment follows from receiving a HEAP benefit in the program year.
The arrears credit component follows from HEAP receipt.
The monthly discount and the arrears credit run together.
A LIHEAP payment reduces the balance amortized under the standard 12-month arrangement.
A CEAP payment reduces the balance covered by a deferred payment plan.

fallbackArrangement.name: Deferred payment arrangement
fallbackArrangement.text: The baseline arrangement available in every state under the applicable PUC rule. Terms come from the state's pucRule.deferredPaymentArrangement.
